mapping.completion_tokens: the single usage.completion_tokens object of the stream, else null
mapping.first_content_at: time.monotonic() when the first content-bearing SSE event was parsed
mapping.sent_at: time.monotonic() immediately before client.stream (send-attempt start, before connection acquisition; null if never sent)
mapping.slo.finish_reason: observed finish_reason (null when absent, contradictory or n/a)
mapping.slo.requested_ignore_eos: ignore_eos of the payload actually sent (constant false)
mapping.terminal_at: time.monotonic() in finally after the response context closed (null if never sent)
